thread:
elaine: Quick sync — we should run a stakeholder 'litmus test' week before GA. Goal: validate SLA wording, docs, support routing, pricing comms and a 24h smoke + 72h burnin with customer-like traffic. Who can own the checklist?

mike: I can own SLA wording. Proposal: initially 99.9% p95 latency SLO for hosted API, 99.95% for Dedicated. Also need clear error budget policy and plan for support tiers. :thumbsup:

nisha: Docs status: top-level API docs done, guides need 1-2 examples for rate limits and retry behaviour. I'll add a 'what to expect during GA' section. ETA EOD Wed.

sam: For burnin, suggest two tracks: 1) synthetic burst tests (100k reqs over 3h) 2) realistic demo apps (simulate 100 customers). We'll capture token-costs, latencies, tail latencies, error rates. Can we get dedicated pool for the test?

elaine: @mike add error budget gating language. @sam ops to confirm capacity window. @nisha add step-by-step called-out for oncall runbook. We'll aim to sign off on the litmus checklist on Friday.

ops-bot: deploy job #2021 completed — private cluster provisioned for burnin (region us-west-2)

mike: For pricing comms: need a short appendix describing expected unit costs under different batch/quant profiles. @finance to review later — @sam can you capture cost snapshot post-burnin?

sam: yes. I'll output a small CSV and include command we use. Example smoke curl:

```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" -d '{"model":"rwd-4b", "prompt":"hello", "max_tokens":32}'
```

nisha: Adding monitoring checklist: token-level billing dashboard, per-model p99 trace, error-rate alerts (>0.5% sustained), and regression alert tied to predefined prompt set.

elaine: Final gate list for signoff: SLA + EB policy, Docs + sample plays, Support routing + oncall runbook, Monitoring + alerts wired into slack, Pricing appendix + cost snapshot. If any of these have outstanding items by Friday 17:00 PST, we delay GA by a week. Agreed?

mike: Agreed.

nisha: Agreed, I have two minor doc TODOs but will finish before EOD Thurs.

sam: Ops confirmed capacity window 03/12 08:00-20:00 PST. I'll start synthetic and demo runs then.

elaine: Great — I'll assemble the checklist in the product repo and ping the exec stakeholders for final signoff. :rocket:

prod-bot: Created checklist issue #424 in product/launch (assignees: elaine, mike, nisha, sam)

elaine: Thanks team — will follow up with a short readout doc template for the execs.
